title: Town of VibeLem neural net weights
description: Serialization format for trained neural network weights consumed by js/sim/agent-loader.js. One weights file drives all players. Nets are vanilla feed-forward MLPs: ReLU hidden layers, linear output, softmax applied at inference (see js/sim/neural-net.js). Trainers export this exact envelope: {version, game_config, network_configs, trained_weights}. All dimensions are derived at runtime from the live feature extractor and engine role list (js/sim/feature-extractor.js over Object.keys(js/engine/01-roles.js ROLES)); they must never be hardcoded, because the role catalog grows with the engine.

version.description: Format version. Bump when the feature layout or network contract changes.

player_count.description: Number of players the nets were trained for. Must match the state at load time.

preset_id.description: Preset the nets were trained on. Informational only.

feature_dim.description: Length of the base feature vector for one player, computed by FeatureExtractor.getFeatureDimension(state) = 16 + R + playerCount * (3R + 5) where R = role_ids.length = Object.keys(engine.ROLES).length for the current engine. Recomputed by agent-loader.js at load time and rejected on mismatch; trainers must derive it from FeatureExtractor.getFeatureDimension({player_count}) rather than hardcoding it. Layout (index ranges): [0..5] phase one-hot (SETUP, SEATS, NIGHT, MORNING, DAY, END); [6] dayNumber/25; [7] night.number/25; [8] alive ratio (alive / playerCount); [9..11] team counts (TOWN, MAFIA, NEUTRAL) / playerCount over all dealt roles; [12..12+R-1] own role one-hot over role_ids; [12+R..12+R+2] own team one-hot (TOWN, MAFIA, NEUTRAL); [15+R] self alive; then per player in seat order, a block of [3 sheriff bits (UNKNOWN, INNOCENT, SUSPICIOUS), R consigliere one-hot (all zeros when unknown), R+1 public claim one-hot + no-claim, R+1 known dead role one-hot + unknown/cleaned].

candidate_dim.description: Length of the candidate block appended to the base features for vote_net and night_net inputs, computed by FeatureExtractor.getCandidateDimension(state) = 3R + 8 where R = role_ids.length for the current engine. Recomputed by agent-loader.js at load time and rejected on mismatch. Layout: [alive, is self, is mafia teammate, 3 sheriff bits (UNKNOWN, INNOCENT, SUSPICIOUS), R consigliere one-hot (all zeros when unknown), R+1 public claim one-hot + no-claim, R+1 known dead role one-hot + unknown/cleaned].

role_ids.description: Ordered role ids matching Object.keys(engine.ROLES). Used for one-hot encoding and claim decoding. No hardcoded role names anywhere else.

network_configs.description: Architecture of each net. vote_net and night_net take the base features plus the candidate block (input_dim = feature_dim + candidate_dim). claim_net takes the base features only (input_dim = feature_dim).

hidden_dims.description: Hidden layer sizes, applied in order with ReLU. Empty array means a linear model.

output_dims.description: vote_net: 3 (GUILTY, INNOCENT, ABSTAIN scores). night_net: 3 (target_aggressive, target_defensive, no_action scores; target selection maximizes aggressive minus no_action). claim_net: role_ids.length (one output per role; no no-claim slot).

weights.description: One matrix per layer (hidden_dims.length + 1). weights[l] is a matrix of shape [outputs_l, inputs_l] with weights[l][j][k] the weight from input k to output j of layer l.

biases.description: One vector per layer; biases[l] has outputs_l entries.
